# Southern Living House Plans

> Southern Living House Plans offers curated residential designs, custom builder programs, and architectural inspiration for homeowners seeking quality Southern-style homes.

Southern Living House Plans is the residential design division of Southern Living, providing house plans, custom builder connections, and home design resources. The platform connects homeowners with architectural designs and construction partners through programs like the Custom Builder Program and Idea House Program.

## Key Topics

- House Plans
- Southern Design
- Custom Builders
- Architectural Design
- Floor Plans
- 5-Bedroom Homes
- Walkout Basements
- Home Construction
- Idea House Program
- Inspired Communities
- Home Design
- Plan Purchase
- Residential Architecture
- Southern Living Brand
